events.description: A man in a checkered jacket is shown with a pained, reactive expression (hand to chin, mouth open) at 60.0–60.5s, followed by two men in yellow shirts (one with facial injury) reacting with shock and tension at 61.0–61.5s, indicating an immediate aftermath of physical combat.

A man lies motionless on the floor with visible facial injuries (swelling, cuts, bruising) from 62.0s onward; his eyes are open but he shows no movement or resistance, consistent with being a helpless victim after assault. Multiple frames (f4–f15) confirm sustained immobility and injury.

A man with severe facial injuries (blood, swelling) is shown upright, restrained by another person holding a sack-like object over his head—suggesting active subduing or ongoing physical confrontation during this interval.

A man (Sammo Hung) is shown with fresh facial injuries (bloody abrasions on cheek and lip, swelling), wearing a dark robe, being held or restrained from behind by an unseen person whose arm and a rope-wrapped sack are visible over his shoulders; his expression is pained and defiant, consistent with recent physical combat.

A different man lies motionless on a wooden floor, face-up, with visible facial injuries (abrasions, swelling, blood near eye and mouth); he appears unconscious or severely incapacitated, suggesting he has been subjected to violent assault by an unseen perpetrator.

A man in black lies prone on the wooden floor inside a roped ring while multiple men in white shirts surround him, leaning over; a hand is visibly pressing down on his head/shoulder area (e.g., f0–f5), indicating control or subjugation of a helpless individual.

The man in black begins to rise from the floor under apparent coercion: he lifts his upper body while a hand remains on his head/neck (visible in f5–f6), and the surrounding group maintains close physical proximity and control, consistent with forced submission.

The man in black is now upright but bent forward, with visible facial bruising (e.g., f8, f9, f10, f14, f15); the crowd remains tightly gathered, some holding cameras, and his posture and injuries indicate prior physical mistreatment and ongoing humiliation within a controlled setting.

Two men engage in a close-quarters boxing/martial arts fight inside a ring; one shirtless with boxing gloves, the other in black attire with visible facial injury, exchanging punches and defensive maneuvers.

Two men engage in close-quarters hand-to-hand combat inside a boxing ring; one shirtless man throws punches while the other defends and counters, with visible impact and motion blur indicating forceful strikes.

Two men engage in a close-quarters boxing match inside a ring; one shirtless with gloves, the other in dark clothing, exchanging rapid punches and grappling, culminating in the shirtless man taking down his opponent.
A man in a black traditional jacket delivers rapid, forceful punches in a combat sequence; his face shows injury (blood on cheek/eye) and intense exertion, consistent with active mutual combat.

A second man (longer hair, also in black) is shown being struck and thrown backward while holding a thick rope; his facial expression and body position indicate he is actively engaged in combat and receiving blows.

A close-up shows a man’s face being forcefully gripped and squeezed by another person’s hand; visible blood, contorted facial expression, and lack of resistance suggest the victim is helpless and being abused.

A hand is shown gripping and pressing into the neck/shoulder area of a prone, seemingly helpless person; the motion appears forceful and controlling, consistent with physical abuse rather than consensual contact or medical aid.

A standing man in black (Chen Zhen) stands over a shirtless opponent lying on the ring floor, holding the opponent's head/neck with one hand while raising his other fist—this is a clear post-combat dominance pose following a fight, occurring within an active boxing ring with referee and spectators present. The sequence from f5 to f15 shows sustained control and threat posture, indicating the immediate aftermath of mutual combat.
A man lies on his back with severe facial injuries, including multiple deep lacerations and blood, indicating he has been violently attacked while helpless.
A man in a white shirt is captured mid-punch, extending his arm forcefully toward an unseen target, surrounded by a crowd watching intently; this is a clear act of physical combat.
A man in black stands in a fighting stance with clenched fists, facing a bald opponent inside a boxing ring, indicating active or imminent mutual physical combat.
Two men engage in a physical fight inside a boxing ring; one bald man in light clothing lunges toward the other man in black, who is in a defensive stance, with spectators raising arms in reaction.
A man lies on his back against a wall, face covered in blood and cuts, mouth open in apparent distress or pain—indicating he has been attacked and is helpless.
